judgment_calls: FeeStructure resolution in reconcile: keys encode the FeeCategory pk (not the FeeStructure pk), so I resolve via (school, enrollment.school_class, term, category_id) — the unique_together tuple — rather than raw pk lookup. This is the only unambiguous way to get the correct amount for the right term.
Stale/malformed keys (e.g. extra:abc, missing FeeStructure, unknown key format) are silently skipped rather than raising; amount validation still guards over/underpayment.

next-term-only selection (one invoice = the next-term invoice): generalized the spec's single-invoice rule to 'one invoice involved' — full amount allocates to it, capped by its balance after additions (amount must equal next_fixed exactly).
If next-term keys are submitted but no next term exists, raise ValidationError (fail loudly rather than silently drop a whole term section).
next_term group is returned as None when the next term exists but there are zero billable categories (avoids an empty 'Next term' section; spec: 'do NOT show a disabled/empty section').
Outstanding-selected-but-no-invoice/zero-balance raises ValidationError('No outstanding balance for {term.name}.') — message not specified, kept descriptive.
amount is defensively coerced via Decimal(amount); TypeError/ValueError/InvalidOperation -> ValidationError('Enter a valid amount.')
current_portion >= extras_fixed is enforced explicitly in the two-invoice branch (redundant with the minimum_payable check but per spec).
